en: Colorized view of stone ruins standing alone in an open grassy park, with a curving dirt path in the foreground. Trees and a few hillside houses appear in the background, along with a small pavilion-like building to the right. The reverse side has printed Hungarian text indicating the location and publisher, laid out in the typical divided-back postcard format.
